basis: The vendor identifies an nscd service stack overflow triggered by an oversized malicious DNS response. This image does not include or run nscd. The presence of glibc source-package sibling binaries alone does not supply that service.
required_evidence: fresh exact-image no-network read-only inspection: complete installed dpkg package list and filesystem traversal excluding only proc/sys/dev; no nscd package, command or path
scope: only this image without additional nscd mounts or installation; re-evaluate any image/package/finding change
refresh_reason: Fresh vulnerability metadata now rates this exact finding MEDIUM. Vendor still requires nscd enabled; component absence is re-proven for every exact image. No package upgrade, fixed claim or generic severity exception.
